sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 售货员：您要什么茶？
blocks.en: Salesperson: What tea would you like?

blocks.zh: 安妮：我先看看。这里茶叶这么多，究竟买哪种好呢？
blocks.en: Annie: I’ll look first. There is so much tea here—which kind should I buy?

blocks.zh: 售货员：茶叶主要分为红茶、绿茶等，看您喜欢喝哪种。
blocks.en: Salesperson: Tea is mainly divided into black tea, green tea and so on. It depends on what you like.

blocks.zh: 安妮：我想买一些自己喝，再买些送人。这种绿茶还有吗？
blocks.en: Annie: I want some for myself and some as gifts. Do you still have this green tea?

blocks.zh: 售货员：抱歉，暂时没有。如果自己喝，可以买这个绿茶，今天满二两送半两，超过半斤再送小礼物；如果送人，可以买个盒子装进去。
blocks.en: Salesperson: Sorry, it is temporarily unavailable. For yourself, you could buy this green tea: buy two liang today and get half a liang free, plus a gift for purchases over half a jin. For a gift, you can buy a box to pack it in.

blocks.zh: 安妮：嗯。那就先买六两这种绿茶吧，再买一个盒子。请帮我分着装，盒子里装半斤，剩下的用纸包一下就行。
blocks.en: Annie: Then I’ll buy six liang of this green tea and a box. Please pack them separately: half a jin in the box and the rest wrapped in paper.

blocks.zh: 安妮为什么要买茶叶？
blocks.en: Why does Annie buy tea?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 她想买一些自己喝，再买些送人。
answers.en: She wants some for herself and some as gifts.

blocks.zh: 关于买茶叶送人，售货员有什么建议？
blocks.en: What does the salesperson suggest for tea gifts?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 可以买个盒子把茶叶装进去。
answers.en: She can buy a box to put the tea in.

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 安妮到茶叶店买茶叶，售货员问她……。她不知道究竟买……，售货员向她介绍了不同的茶叶。安妮想买一些茶……，再……。但她想买的一种绿茶……。售货员向她介绍说，自己喝的话，可以……，今天……，超过半斤再送……；送人的话，可以买个……。安妮最后买了……，盒子里……，……用纸包起来了。
prompt.en: Annie went to buy tea. The assistant asked…. She was unsure which…. She wanted tea for … and…. The desired green tea was…. The assistant recommended … and explained the offer…. Annie bought …, put … in a box and wrapped … in paper.

answer.zh: 安妮到茶叶店买茶，想买一些自己喝，再买些送人。她想买的绿茶暂时没有。售货员推荐另一种绿茶，今天满二两送半两，超过半斤还有小礼物；送人的茶可以装进盒子。安妮最后买了六两绿茶和一个盒子，盒子里装半斤，剩下的用纸包起来。
answer.en: Annie wanted tea for herself and gifts. Her chosen tea was unavailable. The assistant recommended another green tea with a buy-two-liang, get-half-free offer and a gift for purchases over half a jin. Annie bought six liang and a box, packing half a jin in the box and wrapping the rest in paper.

sections.title: Grammar 1 · 究竟

blocks.zh: 这里茶叶这么多，究竟买哪种好呢？
blocks.en: There is so much tea here; which kind should I buy?

blocks.zh: 我一直没找到他，他究竟去哪里了呢？
blocks.en: I still cannot find him. Where exactly has he gone?

blocks.zh: 究竟是对还是错？我现在也不清楚。
blocks.en: Is it right or wrong? I am not sure either.

blocks.heading: Book practice · 1

answers.en: whether she likes it

answers.en: When exactly can you finish writing?

blocks.en: A: Ask for a definite choice. B: I have not decided; let me think.
blocks.heading: Book practice · 3

sections.intro: 究竟 is used in questions to press for the truth or a definite answer.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 广播员：各位顾客，本商场正在举办运动鞋假日低价促销活动，全场五折。
blocks.en: Announcer: Dear customers, our mall is holding a holiday sports-shoe sale, with everything at half price.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：一飞，广播里说价格减了一半呢，咱们过去看看？
blocks.en: Wang Yixue: Yifei, the announcement says prices are halved. Shall we look?

blocks.zh: 王一飞：好的。不过咱们也不能只听广告说什么，还得看质量。
blocks.en: Wang Yifei: Yes, but we cannot only listen to advertising; we must check quality.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：对，首先看样子喜不喜欢，然后再看质量怎么样、价格合适不合适。
blocks.en: Wang Yixue: Right. First see whether we like the style, then check quality and price.

blocks.zh: 售货员：二位看看喜欢哪双？这个牌子质量很好，今天又降价，一双减300块。
blocks.en: Salesperson: Which pair do you like? This brand is good quality and is reduced by 300 yuan per pair today.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：嗯，我知道这个牌子。一飞，你喜欢吗？你看，这个鞋的样式很新，价钱也不高。
blocks.en: Wang Yixue: I know this brand. Yifei, do you like it? The style is new and the price is not high.

blocks.zh: 王一飞：你喜欢就买吧。我再看看别的。
blocks.en: Wang Yifei: Buy it if you like it. I’ll look at others.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：好的。请给我拿一双37号的吧。
blocks.en: Wang Yixue: All right. Please bring me a size 37 pair.

blocks.zh: 听了广播后，王一雪为什么要过去看看？
blocks.en: Why does Wang Yixue want to look after hearing the announcement?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 因为运动鞋的价格减了一半。
answers.en: Because sports shoes are half price.

blocks.zh: 王一雪是怎么决定买那双运动鞋的？
blocks.en: How does she decide to buy those shoes?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 她知道这个牌子，觉得样式很新，质量好，价钱也不高。
answers.en: She knows the brand and finds the style new, quality good and price low.

sections.title: Grammar 2 · 首先……然后／其次……

blocks.zh: 首先看样子喜不喜欢，然后再看质量怎么样、价格合适不合适。
blocks.en: First consider the style, then the quality and price.

blocks.zh: 遇到问题，首先想想问题为什么出现，然后再积极想办法解决。
blocks.en: When problems arise, first consider their cause, then actively seek a solution.

blocks.zh: 请大家首先读一遍课文，然后根据课文完成课后练习。
blocks.en: First read the text once, then complete the exercises based on it.

blocks.zh: A：请说说你们的计划。 B：我们的计划是，首先去做市场调查，____。
blocks.en: Explain the next step after market research.
blocks.heading: Book practice · 1

answers.zh: 然后根据结果准备材料
answers.en: then prepare materials based on the results

blocks.zh: A：你们寒假是怎么安排的？ B：____；其次，____。
blocks.en: Describe two winter-holiday arrangements.
blocks.heading: Book practice · 2

answers.zh: 首先我们要复习功课；其次，我们想去看家人
answers.en: First we will review our lessons; then visit our families.

blocks.zh: A：能谈谈你为什么觉得自己适合这份工作吗？ B：首先我的专业是儿童教育，____。
blocks.en: Add a second reason for being suitable for the job.
blocks.heading: Book practice · 3

answers.zh: 其次我很喜欢和孩子们在一起
answers.en: Second, I enjoy spending time with children.

sections.intro: 首先……然后／其次…… expresses sequence or the distinction between primary and secondary points.

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 李文的朋友徐前在商业区开了家小店，专门卖年轻人喜欢的东西。他的店里商品种类不少，既有几十年前的老游戏机，也有最近流行的盲盒等等，很吸引年轻人。
blocks.en: Li Wen’s friend Xu Qian opened a small shop in a business district selling things young people like. It offers many kinds of goods, from old game consoles to fashionable blind boxes, attracting young customers.

blocks.zh: 徐前说，自己就是年轻人，知道年轻人喜欢什么。他也常和来店里的年轻顾客聊天儿，了解他们的兴趣爱好。前段时间刚进的盲盒很快就卖到了缺货。许多年轻人表示，在徐前的店里能感受到快乐。小店虽然小，但东西适合年轻人，加上店员态度友好，使得小店的生意越来越好。李文觉得自己的朋友真会做生意。
blocks.en: Xu says that as a young person he knows young people’s tastes. He often talks with customers to learn their interests. Newly stocked blind boxes quickly sold out. Customers say the shop makes them happy. Suitable goods and friendly staff have made business increasingly successful. Li thinks his friend is good at business.

blocks.zh: 年轻人为什么喜欢徐前店里的东西？
blocks.en: Why do young people like the shop’s goods?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 因为商品种类多，适合年轻人的兴趣爱好。
answers.en: Because there is variety and the goods match young people’s interests.

blocks.zh: 徐前店里的生意做得怎么样？
blocks.en: How is business at Xu’s shop?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 生意越来越好，盲盒很快就卖到了缺货。
answers.en: Business is improving; blind boxes quickly sold out.

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 李文的朋友徐前在商业区……，专门卖……。他的店里商品……，既有几十年前的……，也有……等等，很吸引年轻人。徐前说，自己……，知道年轻人……。他也常和来店里的……，了解……。前段时间刚进的盲盒很快就……。许多年轻人表示，在徐前的店里能……。小店虽然小，但东西……，加上店员……，使得小店的生意……。李文觉得自己的朋友……。
prompt.en: Complete the account of Xu’s shop: its location, products, customers, sold-out blind boxes, friendly staff and successful business.

answer.zh: 徐前在商业区开了家小店，专门卖年轻人喜欢的东西。店里既有老游戏机，也有流行的盲盒。他自己就是年轻人，也经常和顾客聊天儿，所以知道他们的兴趣爱好。盲盒很快就卖到了缺货。东西适合年轻人，加上店员态度友好，使得生意越来越好。李文觉得徐前很会做生意。
answer.en: Xu opened a shop in a business district for young customers, selling old game consoles and popular blind boxes. As a young person who talks with customers, he understands their interests. Blind boxes sold out quickly. Suitable products and friendly staff made business improve. Li thinks Xu is skilled at business.

sections.title: Grammar 3 · 加上

blocks.zh: 小店虽然小，但东西适合年轻人，加上店员态度友好，使得小店的生意越来越好。
blocks.en: The shop is small, but suitable goods and friendly staff make business improve.

blocks.zh: 虽然这里是郊区，但周围交通很方便，加上房租便宜，所以很多年轻人都在这里租房子。
blocks.en: Although it is outside the city, convenient transport and cheap rent attract young renters.

blocks.zh: 他很聪明，加上一直非常努力，所以最后考上了理想的大学。
blocks.en: He is intelligent and consistently hardworking, so he entered his ideal university.

blocks.zh: 这些茶叶闻着很香，____，我一下就买了两斤。（促销）
blocks.en: The tea smells fragrant; add a reason involving a promotion.
blocks.heading: Book practice · 1

answers.en: and the shop was running a promotion

blocks.zh: 这个话剧很有名，____，来剧院看演出的观众____。（超过）
blocks.en: Add a reason and a result using “exceed”.
blocks.heading: Book practice · 2

answers.zh: 加上票价不高；超过了一千人
answers.en: and tickets are inexpensive; exceeded one thousand

blocks.zh: 这位售货员很专业，____，很快就卖出去了好几个手机。（态度）
blocks.en: Add a reason about attitude.
blocks.heading: Book practice · 3

answers.en: and has a friendly attitude

sections.intro: 加上 adds another factor to the previous clause, leading to a result.

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: 关于购物，你是一位冷静购物者，还是不冷静购物者？一般来说，冷静购物者往往是真正需要一件东西时才买。购买时，还会从质量、价格等各方面仔细比较。不冷静购物者看见一个东西时，只要感觉喜欢就买，不管需要不需要，结果常常买完就后悔，买的东西也成了“垃圾”，还不环保。王一飞说，她从来不随便买东西。对于想买的东西，她不光看质量，还看价格。无论是一件外套，还是一条裤子，甚至一双袜子，都是仔细比较后才决定买不买。
blocks.en: Are you a careful or impulsive shopper? Careful shoppers buy only when something is genuinely needed and compare quality, price and other factors. Impulsive shoppers buy what they like regardless of need, often regretting it and creating waste. Wang Yifei never buys casually. She checks both quality and price, carefully comparing even coats, trousers and socks before deciding.

blocks.zh: 其实，不仅是买东西，人生的很多事情都一样，选择合适的才是最好的。
blocks.en: This applies not only to shopping but to many things in life: choosing what suits you is best.

blocks.zh: 冷静购物者和不冷静购物者最大的不同是什么？
blocks.en: What is the main difference between careful and impulsive shoppers?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 冷静购物者需要才买，不冷静购物者喜欢就买。
answers.en: Careful shoppers buy when needed; impulsive shoppers buy when they like something.

blocks.zh: 王一飞是冷静购物者吗？为什么？
blocks.en: Is Wang Yifei a careful shopper? Why?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 是，她仔细比较质量和价格后才决定买不买。
answers.en: Yes. She compares quality and price before deciding.

sections.title: Grammar 4 · 对于

blocks.zh: 对于想买的东西，她不光看质量，还看价格。
blocks.en: For things she wants to buy, she checks both quality and price.

blocks.zh: 对于他的做法，大家都很支持。
blocks.en: Everyone supports his approach.

blocks.zh: 对于你们提的这个建议，我们一定好好研究。
blocks.en: We will carefully study your suggestion.

blocks.zh: 对于这份工作，____。

blocks.zh: 你平时一般怎么购物？请根据你去超市或商场买东西的经历，写一篇短文，不少于140字。
blocks.en: Describe how you usually shop, using a supermarket or mall experience. Write at least 140 Chinese characters.
blocks.heading: Writing · at least 140 characters

answers.zh: 我平时买东西以前，首先想一想自己究竟需要什么，然后再去商场比较。有一次，我想买一件外套。商场里很多商品都在促销，一件红色外套的价格减了一半。我没有马上买，而是先看质量，再试一试大小。售货员的态度很友好，也给我介绍了别的样式。最后我发现另一件外套更适合我，虽然贵一点儿，但是可以穿很久。我觉得购物时不光要看价格，还要看自己需不需要。只买合适的东西，既能少花钱，也不会让家里放满没有用的商品。
answers.en: Before shopping I consider what I need and compare products. Once I needed a coat and saw a red one at half price. I checked quality and fit instead of buying immediately. A friendly salesperson showed other styles. Another coat suited me better and would last longer despite costing more. Shopping means considering need as well as price; buying suitable things saves money and avoids clutter.
